description_en: Queries the compliance packs in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的合规包列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-compliance-packs --status ACTIVE --risk-level 1 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateCompliancePacks

parameters.help_en:
The status of the compliance pack. Valid values:

ACTIVE: The compliance pack is active.

CREATING: The compliance pack is being created
parameters.help_zh:
合规包状态。取值：
ACTIVE：正常。
CREATING：创建中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the compliance pack. Valid values:

1: high

2: medium

3: low
parameters.help_zh:
合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can add up to 20 tags to a resource
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag
